instruction:
Open /home/user/Desktop/plate_a.step and /home/user/Desktop/plate_b.step using BRL-CAD. Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). For this task, BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `plate_a.step`.

Align the two plate centers and fuse them into a cross-shaped base. Cut one central through hole of diameter 16 mm through the base. Add one cylindrical pin at the center of each of the four arm end faces; each pin has diameter 10 mm, length 8 mm, and its axis aligned with its arm direction. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl.
